 Christian Anderson Jr. leads bench in loss to Clippers 
 by Garrett Ball | Hornets Correspondent | Mon, Nov 16th 2026, 10:55am EST 
 Christian Anderson Jr. scored 16 points (5-10 FG, 4-8 3P, 2-2 FT) with three rebounds, two assists, and two steals in the Hornets’ 113-105 loss to the Clippers on Sunday. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Anderson led the Hornets bench in scoring, and it also marks back-to-back games in double digits for the rookie. He’s slowly working his way into the rotation as a role player, and could see things continue to go his direction if he improves as the season progresses.
